product_metadata.title: Toilet Brush and Holder Set 2 Pack, Domi-patrol Toilet Bowl Brush and Holder White, Hard Bristles Toilet Cleaning Brushes for Bathroom with Holder, Anti Rust Handle Toilet Scrubber Wall Mounted
features: [Detachable Toilet Bowl Brush and Holder] - The toilet brush holder has ventilated drawer to prevent water leakage and water stains problem. The internal hollow design ensures that the water droplets dripping from the brush head can be quickly discharged to the built-in water storage drawer, keeping toilet brush head dry and sanitary. The removable drawer can easily remove excess water and prevent unpleasant odor

[Durable & Effective Cleaning Brush] - Our toilet bowl brush head is made from wear-resistant PP material that is sturdy, wear-resistant, corrosion-resistant and squish down enough to get into the nooks and under the rim. The durable hard bristles can remove the toughest stains on the surface and corner seams. Dense and sturdy bristles helps scrub away hidden dirt easily for more efficient cleaning

[Wall Mounted & Floor Standing] - Our toilet brushes with holders sets can stand on the floor stably, also can be fixed on the wall with a sticker without punching and screws, which can save space and make toilet brushes more hygienic. We provide two adhesive stickers, you could hang the toilet cleaning brush set in different place. Compact and space-saving design fits well into tight bathroom areas. Perfect for apartment, condo, dorms, cabins

[Ergonomic Bathroom Toilet Brush] - The toilet bowl brush handle is designed in stainless steel and PP plastic two sections, not only it will not rust, but also give you a pleasant cleaning experience. Designed with ergonomic non-slip handle is comfortable to grip, allows you easier to clean and reducing cleaning time. Our toilet cleaning brushes are easy to assembly and disassemble. Extended handle design keep your hands from dirty water

[360° Deep Cleaning Brush] - This bristle toilet brush head can clean deeply your toilet without blind angle, including the dead corner inside the toilet. Meanwhile, our toilet bowl brush specially designed with a hidden tweezers in the top of brush handle. You can easily pull the tweezers out and clean hair and debris on your sinks and bathtubs. No need to get your hands dirty and keep your bathroom perfectly clean
